Second disagreement, the 2026-10-27 run (`~/lloyd-data/logs/calibrate-3179-postlanding-.log`, footer `2/4 agree`): a test-honesty finding that `tests/test_trajectory_extraction.py:964` defines `_live_buckets()` reading `_ROOT / _pipeline`, absent both in that graded worktree and in the live checkout. Whether that `pass` or the grader's `retry` is correct — i.e. whether the fixture or `grade_commit`'s range model is what is wrong — is the ruling #3179 leaves to the owed-check job; re-marking the case to the graded reality is the record of the disagreement, not its resolution, which is why `provisional: true` stays. `provisional` is a record and not a mute: `compare()` never reads the flag and the CLI exit code does not either, so the FAIL still prints whatever the grader answers.
